author: Beverly Pharr
text: After losing our home in the fires this past April, my husband and I began the stressful search for a new home. We visited several dealerships during that process. Some relied heavily on sales tactics, while others seemed uninterested in helping us at all. Thankfully, our experience at Wayne Frier Home Center in Waycross was completely different. From the very beginning, Donovan was incredibly patient, not only with us but also with my parents, who were searching for a new home after losing theirs in the fires as well. He never pressured us into making a decision or rushed us through the process. We spent a lot of time comparing homes and even went back and forth between Wayne Frier and another dealership to ensure we were making the right choice. Throughout it all, Donovan and the entire team remained professional, helpful, and understanding. Given everything we had already gone through, the last thing we needed was additional stress. The team at Wayne Frier made the purchasing process as painless as possible and treated us with kindness and respect every step of the way. I honestly cannot say enough good things about them and would highly recommend working with Donovan and the staff at Wayne Frier. That said, my review of the home itself is a different story. We chose a Live Oak home because of its reputation for quality, and unfortunately, our experience has not lived up to those expectations. If I were rating only the quality of the home, I would give it 3 stars. Since taking delivery, we have found numerous defects and quality-control issues that should have been identified and corrected before the home left the factory. The list of problems has been much longer than we anticipated for a brand-new home. However, many of our issues have been addressed and resolved. My criticism is not directed at Wayne Frier, as they have been helpful throughout the process. Rather, it is directed at Live Oak Homes and the factory's quality control standards. I strongly believe more attention should be given to inspecting these homes before they are delivered to customers. Overall, I give Wayne Frier Home Center a well-deserved recommendation for their outstanding customer service, patience, and professionalism. I only wish the quality of the home had matched the quality of the people who sold it.

author: Laura Mock
text: Review gist for those who plan on BUILDING a home with Wayne Frier in Waycross. Timeline from start to finish: February 3 - July 25, 2024 We had a wonderful experience with Wayne Frier in Waycross, especially with Donovan. We live in Nassau County and are very close to the same retailer in Macclenny. After reviewing the reviews and visiting both sites, Macclenny and Waycross, we decided it was worth the extra 1.5 hours to Waycross. Day one in Waycross, we were greeted by all the staff, Donovan showed us around several houses. He was very accommodating and patient, since we brought our twin babies. They will never know how much this worrisome mom of four appreciated their kindness, patience and simplicity of purchasing our home. We decided on the Fancy 4/3 and snagged a great deal by building our home. Donovan made the process simple by communicating every detail by email, saving us many trips out there. We took our time trying to find the right lender for us and Wayne Frier of Waycross was patient and helped us find the right lender, Union Home Mortgage. They were with us the entire time even through rate fluctuations. (Sorry about that. Mr. D.) We wanted a house that would be our forever home, but didn’t want all the stress that came along with building a house… IYKYK I told him that I was a teacher and gave him a completion timeline of July, so I could have time to move in. Donovan let us know all of our options and helped us choose something that looked like home, even going through many of the lot models to compare different house interior styles and colors… in the rain… again with children! The house was built in NO time (Less than the 6 weeks quoted or at least it seemed). The permits took a bit to process (Nassau County, pssf.), but Donovan and others at Wayne Frier kept me in the loop about timeline/project projections/ETCs. We had a few hiccups with the quality of flooring, the Plant Factory Manager quickly remedied the issue. Any punch list items that we had Wayne Frier and Mr. Bruce, from the Plant. quickly fixed each issue to MY standard, knowing about my timeline. Everyone from Wayne Frier; the associates, plant managers and the contractors were very accommodating and kind throughout the entire process. I’m a very particular person and yet they were patient and helpful from day one. I would recommend the trip down to Wayne Frier if you are looking for a beautiful home. I’ve already sent another customer to Waycross, (I think they should be getting their home delivered now, if not already) and I’m sending them another soon and will do so to anyone else looking to buy a home. Thank you, Donovan and Wayne Frier Waycross, for your hand in creating our family’s forever home. BTW, We moved in on our birthday!
